meta.centralIdea: Human judgment. Agent execution. One workflow.

agentStates.label: Idle
agentStates.meaning: Agent is available but not executing work.

agentStates.label: Interpreting
agentStates.meaning: Agent is resolving intent, context and constraints.

agentStates.label: Working
agentStates.meaning: Agent is actively executing internal work.

agentStates.label: Draft ready
agentStates.meaning: Output is ready for Human review or downstream workflow.

agentStates.label: Review required
agentStates.meaning: Human judgment is required before further execution.

agentStates.label: Executing
agentStates.meaning: Approved action is being carried out.

agentStates.label: Completed
agentStates.meaning: Work finished and outcome/report is available.

agentStates.label: Failed
agentStates.meaning: Execution failed or cannot continue safely.

agentStates.label: Blocked
agentStates.meaning: Agent cannot proceed due to missing permission/context/dependency.

provenance.explanationStyle: Operational summary: what was considered, what changed, evidence/source, uncertainty, and next action.

supervisor.purpose: Control execution quality, risk, permission and workflow compliance.
supervisor.principle: Supervisor is usually invisible when everything is healthy; surface only when intervention is needed.

automation.externalAction: requires visible approval when policy/risk demands it
